reason: In this Collenette entry, 'no scent' comes straight after the flowers, so 'flower not odorous' is the right reading.
The corolla is 3.5–4.5 cm, and a single size for a corolla means its length.
The flora says the stamens are shorter than the corolla, with the corolla as the comparison part.

fix: 'ovate- or obovate-rhomboid' shares one ending: read it as ovate-rhomboid OR obovate-rhomboid. Only the second half was annotated, so add the first (ovate→rhomboid) as well.
reason: Reading obovate-rhomboid as a shape between obovate and rhomboid matches the flora. The ovate-rhomboid half is missing, but what was annotated is true.
The flora says the auricles are absent. The oral setae should get their own absence record.
'Unarmed' means the plant has no spines or prickles, so 'whole plant not spiny' is right.
'Tree' means a tree-like (arborescent) habit. The word 'tall' is not captured, but nothing stated is false.
'Seeds wingless' means the seed is not winged.
9–11 secondary veins on each side of the midvein, inside the leaf blade. The count and its position are right.
The three alternative shapes are right, and they are said of the leaves.

fix: 'beneath X between the nerves and more densely Y upon them' gives two places. Y belongs on the veins of the lower surface; X (short-pilose) belongs between the veins.
reason: The flora says the denser pubescence is on the nerves. Putting 'pubescent' on the whole lower surface drops the place slot.
'Shreddy' bark peels off in strips, which fits the definition of FLOPO exfoliating.
The flora says the bracts are several to many times longer than the culms. 'Culm' is a synonym of PO stem.
1–3 bracteoles.
9–15 secondary veins on each side of the midvein, inside the leaf blade.

fix: In comparisons, 'Filaments shorter than X' must keep the filament (PO_0009067) as the part. It should not be widened to the whole stamen.
reason: The comparison is made for the filaments, not the whole stamens (which include the anthers).
'Curved' is said of the corolla tube in the open flower, so 'corolla curved' with the open-flower stage holds. It is slightly unclear whether 'curved' refers to the tube or the lobes.
'Fruits ... fleshy'.
In PATO, 'entire' and 'dentated' are margin shapes of the leaf blade. The alternatives are right, and 'denticulate to coarsely dentate' falls under dentated.
The first dimension in 'A by B' is the length: 12–23 cm, with a rare low value of 8.
'Subovate' means approximately ovate. FLOPO_0991024 is the temporary ovate class.

fix: 'Longer than ovary and style' compares to the ovary and style taken together. Better target: the gynoecium/pistil (PO_0009062), or both parts.
reason: If the stamens are longer than the ovary and style, they are longer than the ovary, so the annotation is true but weaker than the flora.

fix: The word 'midvein' was taken as the container (PO_0005020, vascular bundle). The container should be the leaf blade. Also, 'ca. N' should set value_qualifier = approximately.
reason: The secondary veins belong to the leaf blade, not to a vascular bundle. The count is also given as approximate ('ca. 11'), but it was recorded as exact.

fix: 'whitish X' is a pale X: map 'whitish green' to pale green (FLOPO_0988169), not to plain green level 2.
reason: Mapping 'whitish green' to green turns the range into green-to-green and loses the paleness.
Terminal leaflets are 1.4–5 cm long. 'Terminal' (PATO_0002476) is kept as a context quality of the part.

fix: 'palmatiséqué' / 'palmatisect' means cut to or nearly to the base. Map it to FLOPO palmatisect (added 2026-11-14), not to palmately lobed. 'palmatilobé à palmatiséqué' is a range from lobed to dissected.
reason: Palmatisect means more deeply divided than lobed, and a term for it exists.
7–11 lobes on the leaf blade.
A single size given for the seed is its length: 0.4–0.6 mm.
The terminal leaflet is densely white-tomentose beneath, and the lower surface is used as the part. A leaflet-specific lower-surface class would be more exact.
The height of the herb converts correctly from dm to cm: 40–180 cm, with rare values of 20 and 220.
